purpose: Fast machine-readable slash-command router for browser AIs, IDE AIs, MCP clients, and Companion-assisted Kiwe workflows.

entry.rule: Treat explore as a location pointer, not permission to crawl the repository. Read this manifest or KIWE-AI.md, then route the next slash command.

readPolicy: Do not read the whole repository.
Read only the context files listed for the matched command.
Prefer this JSON manifest first when available because it is smaller and less ambiguous than prose.
If a required artifact is missing, stop with a compact diagnostic instead of guessing.
globalRules.documentation: Documentation is opt-in. Do not create README, NOTES, reports, duplicate previews, ZIP files, or explanation documents unless /document is present or the human explicitly asks.
globalRules.finalResponse: Return a compact result: PASS/FAIL/WARN, files changed, files kept/removed when relevant, validator/audit status, and remaining warnings. Do not write long essays.
globalRules.companion: /usecompanion is optional and non-blocking. Make one bounded call when credentials exist; if it fails, continue without it and report fallback.
globalRules.structure: Fix commands preserve the existing artifact lane. They must not restart creative work, silently change lanes, or create unrelated packages.
